sermon.title: Can Our Past Limit God’s Present Promises? — January 10, 2021
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer begins John 11, where Jesus promised Lazarus’s sickness was not unto death. The disciples forgot that promise out of fear from the past. We hinder God’s purpose by yesterday’s fears, and past hurts — like a young wife’s abuse — need not define us. Through His blood, every sin is forgiven and we can let the past go.

chunks.section_question: What should we do with our past?
chunks.short_answer: Let go; in His blood all sins are forgiven and He writes His word on our hearts.
chunks.text:
Forgive. If you’re weighed down with guilt. About your past. And troubled and in fear of your past. Punishing you today give it to Jesus. He took the pain the blame and the shame that you might live an abundant life for him father we ask you to bless this bread as we partake of it. We thank you Lord for taking all the shame all the blame all the pain and we can live a blessed life for you let’s eat it together. Likewise he took the cup. And he says and this is his words this is the new covenant.

In my blood. I will write my words on your mind in your heart. All will know me from the least to the greatest you won’t have to have anybody teaching you to know the Lord every one of you will know the Lord and your sins and your iniquities I will remember no more. As you confess them and I will be your supernatural God. And you will be my people that I will do supernatural things to you’re going to be my children of light. In this night of darkness in the earth. The Bible says by stripes we were healed. By the blood.

All sins are forgiven. So just take your sins now to him take anything you want to heal to him and as we drink this cup just accept his healing into your life today let’s drink together. And all because he loves you and me. He loves you so much your lack of faith is not going to hinder him moving in your life. Your fears of yesterday isn’t going to hinder him from moving in your life today.

So let go of the past. And let God move in you with his present worth his present power setting you free with his present truth. We’re receiving your power and we thank you Lord that you’re not limited by our faith. Limited by our unbelief. But you will fulfill the promise. That you begin in us. In Jesus name. We thank the Lord.

And everybody said. Amen. So be it let it be done. I trust today you took your anger to Christ if you’re the angry one in your marriage. I trust today you’re the victim that you get the strength to stand up for yourself. And fight against evil in your home. I trust that you let Jesus come and speak to you a present word that set you free. Hallelujah. You.

faqs.question: Does God want miracles to stop at helping the family of God?
faqs.answer: No. Helping the family of God and others is not where God wants to stop miracles; He also does what humans cannot find a cure for.
